items.title: 3 Undervalued Stocks Trading Below Fair Value By At Least 25%
items.summary: Democrats have just taken control of both chambers of Congress, and markets are quickly repricing what tighter fiscal policy and heavier AI regulation might mean for growth stocks and richly valued themes. Attention shifts back to companies where hard cash flow matters more than hype. That creates an opening in quieter corners of the market where cash rich businesses still trade at discounts. items.title: Bill Ackman: Netflix “an Incredibly Cheap Stock” After a 55% Drop. But Is He Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBill Ackman called Netflix “an incredibly cheap stock” on CNBC’s Squawk Pod, after his fund sold out of most of its Alphabet stake and with Netflix down about 55% from its June 2025 high. Ackman says viewing hours are falling because Netflix’s content mix is changing, and Netflix’s churn improved year over year in the third quarter.

items.title: Why Bill Ackman Says He Feels Like “Markets Are Broken” Casinos
items.summary: Bill Ackman called today's stock market a leverage-fueled casino, then admitted the chaos is good for his firm. The tension between his warning and his buy list raises a question every Pershing Square investor should ask.

items.title: Netflix Is Playing a Bigger Game. Investors Should Take Notice
items.summary: Netflix posted record profits, bought back nearly $5 billion of its own stock, and signed deals with Disney and the NFL, yet shares sit just above a 52-week low. Something about that gap deserves a closer look.

items.title: Netflix (NFLX) Appoints Darshan Kantak To Lead Global Ads Push
items.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS: NFLX) has appointed former Google executive Darshan Kantak as VP to lead its global ads platform. Kantak will oversee engineering, product, and data science for Netflix's advertising unit as the business scales out its ad offering. The hire comes as Netflix prepares to extend its ad supported tier into 15 additional countries in 2027.
